Four hot-pluggable systems (nodes) in a 2U form factor. Each node supports the following:

Dual Socket P (LGA 3647) support
 2nd Gen. Intel® Xeon® Scalable
 processors (Cascade Lake/Skylake)
24 DIMMs; up to 6TB 3DS ECC DDR4-2933MHzRDIMM/LRDIMM, Supports Intel® Optane DCPMM

2 PCI-E 3.0 x16 (LP) slot; 1SIOM card support (flexible networking)
 Note: must bundle with Network card

6 Hot-swap 2.5" NVMe drive bays;
 2 M.2 SATA3 or NVMe support

16 Heavy duty 40x56mm fans
 with optimal fan speed control
 (4 fans per node)

HDS-25N4-015T3-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 15.3TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-007T6-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 7.6TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-003T8-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 3.8TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-001T9-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 1.9TB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

HDS-25N4-960G0-E1-TXD-SED-007.d: SSD 2.5" NVMe PCIe4 960GB 1DWPD TLC D, SED/TCG 7mm

AOC-S25G-I2S-P.d: Std. Low Profile 25G Dual port SFP28, based on Intel XXV710

AOC-S25G-m2S-P.d: 2-ports 25GbE SFP28, based on Mellanox ConnectX-4 LX EN chipset.,RoHS

AOC-SGP-I2.d: 2-ports GbE RJ45 Intel i350-AM2, Gen3 x4 LP

AOC-SGP-I4.d: 4-ports GbE RJ45 Intel i350-AM4, Gen3 x4 LP

AOC-STG-i4T-P.d: 4-ports 10GbE RJ45 Intel XL710-BM2 and X557-AT4, Gen3 x8 LP

AOM-TPM-9670H-S-P.d: SPI Capable Horizontal TPM 2.0 Provisioned for Server

SFT-SDDC-SINGLE.d: SuperCloud Composer (SCC) for Rack Scale Management for Air Cooled Server, security and service integrated features like attestation, call-home. Node License, Up to Gen14, 3 YEARS support

SFT-OOB-LIC.d: Out of Band Firmware Management License-BIOS Flash /Setting, As-Is support

EXS4.d: 1 YR EXT. WRNTY AFTER FRIST YR (SYSTEM ASSEM. ORDER)

AOM-TSR-FS.d: 10G/1G Ethernet 10GBase-SR/SW 1000Base-SX Dual Rate SFP+ 850nm LC Transceiver
